app.title: BLINDSPOT
app.subtitle: Check if you really understand, not just remember.
app.tagline: How sure you felt vs how correct you were

welcome.headline: Check if you really understand, not just remember
welcome.subheadline: Expose the illusion of knowing. Solve real-world situations, discover your Confidence Gap, and master mental models.
welcome.chooseRole: Choose how you want to use BLINDSPOT
welcome.learnerCardDesc: Explore courses, solve real-life transfer problems, find your Confidence Gap, and repair misconceptions.
welcome.adminCardDesc: Create courses with auto-generated AI scenarios, manage course lifecycles, and view class analytics.

home.headline: Move beyond memorization. Build real understanding.
home.pitch: Students often think 'I recognize this' means 'I understand this'. BLINDSPOT gives you real-life practice situations to uncover your Confidence Gap.
home.threeStepTitle: How it works in 3 simple steps
home.step1Desc: Review short, clear concepts in plain English, Tamil, or Hindi.
home.step2Desc: Solve everyday situations that cannot be answered by simple memorization.
home.step3Desc: See where your confidence differed from reality, and repair flaws with Socratic hints.
